feature: ring-hash child policy inside ordinary Channel weighted_target

contracts: weighted_target chooses only READY children before delegating the request to a child picker
each ring child interprets metadata and explicit request hash with its own config
exact duplicate endpoint identities collapse and contribute summed weight
explicit hashes stick to pending primaries but advance clockwise past failed primaries
a missing configured header uses a random fallback hash

implementation.ownership: each leaf deep-copies requestHashHeader and independently owns its capped ketama ring
implementation.membership: ring construction includes only slots under the leaf hierarchical prefix
implementation.deduplication: exact identities share one logical ring index and saturating-sum their weights
implementation.duplicate_readiness: any reusable duplicate can serve its logical identity when the representative is in backoff
implementation.request_input: ordinary unary and stream descriptions pass borrowed metadata plus explicit hash into the synchronous picker
implementation.selection_order: the weighted parent selects a READY child before that leaf resolves its request hash
implementation.fallback: backoff, disabled, or failed logical identities advance clockwise while an eligible pending primary remains sticky
implementation.reconciliation: replacement address sets rebuild all child rings transactionally before publication

native_cases: duplicate a weights 1 and 2 plus b weight 1 produce an exact 9:3 virtual-node split on a 12-entry ring
a weight-100 endpoint under another target contributes zero entries
a READY duplicate serves a while its first identical slot remains in backoff
header a_0 and b_0 route to exact real h2c backends even when the explicit hash names the opposite backend
header c_0 advances from a failed primary to a healthy clockwise successor
missing x-shard metadata uses random fallback and still reaches a READY child endpoint
duplex metadata selects b and completes one message plus OK terminal
ServiceConfig is destroyed immediately after Channel initialization
ring header and recursive runtime construction pass every induced allocation failure

negative_boundary.hostname_targets: ordinary weighted-target remains limited to static resolved endpoints

verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='ordinary weighted target ring hash collapses child endpoints' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC ordinary weighted target ring hash' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC ordinary weighted target' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='ordinary weighted target runtime deep copy' --summary all
remaining_gap: ordinary WRR, outlier, hostname runtime support and dynamic service-config child retention remain before broad parity
